title: Contain the Penetration 4v4
description: Four defenders focus purely on stopping dribble penetration into the paint, rotating and recovering as a group whenever the ball gets past the first line.

content.objective: Stop the ball from reaching the paint as a team, not relying on one defender alone.
content.setup: Four offensive players attack live against four defenders in a half-court setup.
instructions: The offense looks to penetrate the paint off the dribble from any angle.
The nearest defender contains first; a help defender steps in if the ball gets by.
The team rotates to cover any player left open by the help.
Score possessions by stops to track the defense's success.
coachingPoints: Contain before helping — don't give up the ball too easily.
Help from the correct helper, not just whoever reacts first.
Recover to shooters immediately once the ball is kicked back out.
commonMistakes: Multiple defenders collapsing on the ball and leaving two shooters open.
Helping too late once the ball handler is already at the rim.
Ball-watching instead of tracking both the ball and the assignment.
content.safety: Keep penetration drives at a controlled, game-realistic speed.
